ui.title: Doodle Battlefield
ui.hint.empty: Tap a squad to select. Tap an empty tile or press and hold a tile to inspect terrain.
ui.hint.selected: Gold: can move. Red tile: can attack. Red dot: firing range. Green tile: merge.
ui.hint.confirm: Tap the target again or press Attack to confirm.
ui.capture.title: Capture
ui.win.title: Victory!
ui.lose.title: Defeat
ui.win.elimination: The Orcs are wiped off the field.
ui.toast.noSplit: This squad cannot split right now.
ui.toast.pickSplit: Pick an adjacent tile for the new squad.
unit.desc.militia: Cheap, poorly armed. Spears counter cavalry. Merge into regulars to restore them.
unit.desc.infantry: Main melee force, sturdy. Beats archers and militia.
unit.desc.archer: Fires 2–3 tiles, cannot fire when engaged. Farther from hills.
unit.desc.cavalry: Fast, strong charge. Fears militia spears. Cannot climb mountains or enter swamps.
terrain.note.forest: Orcs gain: better defense, easier movement.
terrain.note.hill: High ground: hits harder, archers shoot farther.
terrain.note.mountain: Slow going, cavalry cannot climb. High ground: hits harder.
terrain.note.village: Heals a squad that ends its turn here.
terrain.note.stronghold: Heals its owner's squads. Hold 2 turns to win.
ui.rotate: Landscape is easier to play in
terrain.note.peak: Sheer rock, cannot be climbed or crossed. Go around.
terrain.note.swamp: Mire: slow, lowers defense and damage. Cavalry bog down and cannot enter.
ui.splash.sub: Turn-based tactics on a hand-drawn map
ui.splash.note: Turn the sound on for the best experience
ui.win.survive: Your forces held to the end.
ui.win.destroyed: The enemy camp has been razed.
unit.desc.objective: Losing it means defeat. Static, never fights back, nobody can stand on it. Squads next to their own camp recover 2 troops per turn. Archers and cavalry do poorly against it.
mission.lead.skirmish: Capture the enemy stronghold or wipe out the enemy.
mission.lead.hold: Hold your stronghold until turn {n} ends.
mission.lead.destroy: Raze the enemy camp before they raze yours.
mission.lead.escort: Bring the commander to the extraction point and protect them at all costs.
mission.win.skirmish.1: Capture the enemy stronghold and hold it 2 turns
mission.lose.skirmish.1: The enemy captures your stronghold and holds it 2 turns
mission.win.hold.2: Or capture the enemy stronghold and hold it 2 turns
mission.lose.hold.1: The enemy captures your stronghold and holds it 2 turns
mission.note.hold.1: The enemy outnumbers you from the start
mission.note.hold.2: Both sides get more troops partway; the turn is shown in the top bar
mission.win.destroy.1: Raze the enemy camp: attack it like a squad
mission.note.destroy.1: Each camp has 10 HP, never fights back, and cannot be captured
mission.note.destroy.2: Squads next to their own camp recover 2 troops per turn
mission.note.destroy.3: Infantry and militia do well; archers and cavalry do poorly
mission.win.escort.1: Bring the commander to the extraction point (gold flag tile)
mission.note.escort.1: No strongholds, no capturing, no time limit
mission.note.escort.2: The commander (gold banner) cannot merge into other squads, but others can merge into the commander to heal
ui.save.title: Save / load
ui.save.where.remote: Saved to your account. Survives clearing browser data.
ui.save.where.local: Saved in this browser only; may be lost if site data is cleared. Export a file to keep it.
ui.save.cannotNow: You can only save on your turn, when nothing is animating.
ui.save.savedLocal: Saved in browser (not on your account)
ui.flee.exitElite: About to leave the battle! Loses 1 level
